title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the beverage cooling analysis research task. Generated comprehensive analysis code in code/, produced visualizations in report/images/, and wrote a complete research report in report/report.md. The report includes: 1) Data exploration revealing anomalies at t=80 and t=121 minutes, 2) Piecewise exponential fitting to three segments with Newton's Law of Cooling, 3) Results showing varying cooling constants (k = 0.041-0.078 min⁻¹) and R² values of 0.74-0.81, 4) Discussion of limitations and real-world implications, 5) Conclusion that Newton's Law provides reasonable approximations within stable segments but real cooling is piecewise exponential due to interventions.
